data.one_liner: Check if a point is inside a polygon using the Ray-Casting algorithm.
data.what_it_does: Determines whether a geographic or coordinate point is located inside or outside of a polygon represented by a list of points. It applies a standard ray-casting algorithm to calculate edge intersections.
use_when: You need to check if coordinates fall within a geofenced area or polygonal region.
You are building location-based apps that require simple point-in-polygon checks.
avoid_when: You need complex GIS features, spatial indexing, or advanced map rendering.
You require large-scale spatial databases or spatial querying.
strengths: Simple and lightweight utility for point-in-polygon calculations.
Easy-to-use API requiring only a point and a list of vertices.
weaknesses: Very limited scope focusing only on ray-casting point inclusion.
